condition.keyFindings: A single homogeneous amorphous calcific deposit in the supraspinatus tendon region immediately above the humeral greater tuberosity. No cortical or trabecular architecture within the deposit, no acute fracture, no dislocation and no extra humeral head or scapula. Glenohumeral alignment is preserved.
requiredObservations: An amorphous calcific deposit lies in the rotator-cuff tendon region above the greater tuberosity.
The deposit lacks a bone cortex or internal trabeculae.
The shoulder is aligned with one coherent humeral head and scapula.
